subject: POC hands-on lab scheduling: prompt routing & load validation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC hands-on lab: proposed dates & goals

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum we suggest a 2.5 hour hands-on lab where we pair your engineers with ours. Goals:
- Review the prompt set you shared and validate routing rules for intent-based routing
- Run a short load validation (100–200 rps burst targets) on a representative prompt mix
- Capture latency/cost profiles and confirm autoscaling config recommendations

Proposed windows (PST):
1) Tue Mar 21, 10:00–12:30
2) Wed Mar 22, 13:00–15:30
3) Thu Mar 23, 08:30–11:00

We’ll bring a runbook and a sample prompt file; attaching a short runbook and sample prompts for your review (stubs attached). Please tell us which window works or suggest alternatives.

Logistics: please confirm the list of attendees and whether you want us to run the load from our Dedicated pool or have you run it from a partner environment.

Thanks — looking forward.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-lab-runbook.pdf (pdf), sample-prompts-v1.csv (csv)

Subject: Re: POC hands-on lab: proposed dates & goals

Thanks Monica — great summary. We’re excited to run this. A couple of notes:
- Our core infra lead (internal) is on a customer trip the week of Mar 21, so Wed the 22nd is tight for us.
- Thu Mar 23 morning works best for our team (08:30–11:00 PST looks good).
- Would prefer Redwood to drive the load from Dedicated for a neutral baseline.

Attendees from ClearWave: Sam Choi (PM), Priya N. (Infra lead, will join for the latter half), Daniel F. (Prompt engineer)

If we confirm Thu, can you send a final agenda and any pre-reads? Also, quick Q: for routing tests, can Redwood simulate the multi-intent fallbacks we described?

—Sam

Subject: Re: Confirmed: Thu Mar 23 08:30–11:00 PST — Agenda + pre-reads

Quick notes for the runbook and load plan:
- I recommend we keep burst targets at 50 / 150 / 250 rps but cap sustained at 100 rps for cost reasons — we’ll still collect burst metrics.
- For multi-intent fallback simulation: we can create a routing profile that marks 20% of requests as 'ambiguous' and route those to the lower-cost variant to measure fallthrough latency. That will give ClearWave a conservative cost/latency baseline.
- KV cache: test both cold-start and warmed (we can warm KV with a small prefix warm-up script).

Action items for Thu:
- Aditya: bring the load runner config + scripts (done)
- Karthik: prepare two routing JSON snippets (primary + fallback) and a short slide explaining tradeoffs
- Monica: produce recap template and next-steps owner list

I’ll sync with infra ops to ensure Dedicated pool is available for Thu morning and post here if we need to shift.

Aditya
Sr. Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-lab recap & actions — Thu Mar 23 session follow-up

Sam / team — thanks again for yesterday’s hands-on lab. Short recap and owners below. I’m putting a more formal results doc on the Drive (link below) and will add the final charts once Aditya uploads the raw traces.

Recap (high level):
- Prompt review: validated 18/22 prompt variants; three low-signal templates need rework (see 'sample-prompts-v1.csv' comments).
- Routing: Karthik's fallback profile reduced tail latency for ambiguous intents by ~24% in test bursts at the cost of a 12% increase in average tokens for rerouted prompts.
- Load validation: Dedicated bursts at 50/150/250 rps completed; sustained target capped at 100 rps as agreed. Cold KV runs showed +120ms median latency vs warmed.

Action items (owner — ETA):
- Daniel (ClearWave): update 3 low-signal prompt templates and re-upload (Tue Mar 28 EOD) — 
- Aditya (Redwood): upload raw traces + final latency/cost spreadsheet (Mon Mar 27) — attachments: redwood-lab-runbook.pdf, sample-prompts-v1.csv, routing-config-examples.txt
- Karthik (Redwood): finalize routing JSON snippets and short slide deck for engineering review (Fri Mar 24)
- Monica (Redwood): schedule follow-up sync: propose Wed Mar 29 09:00 PST for results walk-through and next-step decisions

Next session: tentatively Wed Mar 29 09:00–09:45 PST (results review + rollout checklist). I’ll send a calendar invite once the group confirms.

Links: Drive results folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRunbookClearWave

If anything above looks off, please flag. Great collaboration — felt like a productive session.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
